findings.problem: The short adverb her (as in Komm her!) also means here with motion toward the speaker and is very common, so the prompt and hint allow two answers.
findings.fix: hint: to this place, with motion; the long word built on hier, not her

back.target: here, to this place (with motion toward the speaker)

note: aqui-here is a static here, but Spanish also uses aquí for motion (ven aquí), so its picture works well enough for hierher.
